title: Black Bob Thunderbird figurine
subtitle: Chibi figurine of the costume mascot · 80 mm tall on a display base · red, white, black · millimetres

meshes.label: White (beak, eyeballs, highlights, chest blaze, legs, feet, B B)

scale_note: 80 mm tall is a first guess for a 'little' figurine. Type a different height in the real-size box to preview it; HEIGHT_MM in build.py sets it.
notes_title: v17: beak comes to an axe-head point (your pick, C)
notes: v17 = v16 + option C from the four point options. The front of the whole beak, upper and lower, narrows toward an edge like an axe head. Look from the front or the top to see it. The tip end is less rounded, so it also comes to a crisper point from the side. The side shape, arc top, hooked tip and mouth corners are unchanged.
